name: Brian Flores' Psycho Front & Cover 0 Pressure
description: An extreme binary pressure system rooted in Bill Belichick chameleon football and weaponized by Brian Flores into the NFL’s most terrifying pre-snap presentation. By crowding the line of scrimmage with 6 to 7 mugged rushers in the Psycho Front, the defense creates identical pre-snap chaos before either sending an unblockable 7-man Cover 0 house blitz, bluffing and dropping 8 into muddy coverage traps, executing interior A-gap cross-dog twists, or bracketing the offense’s #1 star wide receiver.
